definitions.explanation: One of a pair of ears, or something that applies to only one ear. Commonly used when discussing earphones, hearing, or accessories worn on a single side.

examples.japanese: {片耳|かたみみ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I put an earphone in just one ear.

examples.japanese: {片耳|かたみみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえ→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧にくく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It became hard to hear in one ear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}れる→配る：03921_kubaru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{片耳|かたみみ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ことにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make it a rule to run with an earphone in just one ear so I can stay aware of the sounds around me.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ (one of a pair) and ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ (ear). The prefix ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ is productive in Japanese for indicating one of a paired set: ⟦{片手|かたて}→片手：13462_katate⟧ (one hand), ⟦{片目|かため}→片目：20229_katame⟧ (one eye), {片足|かたあし} (one foot/leg).

Most commonly used in modern contexts when discussing earphones or earbuds, as well as hearing loss affecting one side.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片耳|かたみみ}⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧: single-ear earphone
- {片耳|かたみみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえない→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: deaf in one ear
- {片耳|かたみみ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to wear in one ear only
- {片耳|かたみみ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for one ear; single-sided

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{両耳|りょうみみ}→両耳：25207_ryoumimi⟧: both ears — the counterpart to {片耳|かたみみ}
- ⟦{片目|かため}→片目：20229_katame⟧: one eye — same ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ pattern
- ⟦{片手|かたて}→片手：13462_katate⟧: one hand — same ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ pattern
